fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Green Space; Detached Structure; Walkway; Landscaped Area; Street Frontage; Access Drive; Open Lawn Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Large Paved Surface; Open Terrain; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the street in both directions.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the detached structure.
• Mark or sign the rear access point so responders can locate it quickly without searching the perimeter.
• Keep the rear access route passable for emergency vehicles by preventing parking or storage from blocking it.
• Trim any landscaping along the access drive that narrows the travel width or reduces visibility for approaching vehicles.
• Identify a designated staging area on the large paved surface and keep it free of vehicles and equipment.
• Keep gates or barriers at secondary access points unlocked or equipped with a rapid-entry method.
• Mark a clear walking path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move quickly between buildings at night or in smoke.

wildfire.conditions: Open Terrain; Scattered Trees; Scattered Trees; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Green Space; Scattered Shrubs; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang close to the house to create separation between the trees and the structure.
• Thin scattered trees near the house so they do not form a connected path toward the structure.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or immediately next to the house.
• Separate shrub clusters from nearby trees so vegetation does not form a continuous mass leading toward the structure.
• Keep the open green space areas around the structure mowed short and free of dead plant material.
• Clear any dead or dry vegetation from under scattered trees near the house.
• Maintain open ground between shrub groupings and the structure on all sides.
